name: Tachibana Erika
source:
Hobbies: Burning fallen leaves in bonfires
Skills: Memorizing [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ogura_Hyakunin_Isshu]Hyakunin Isshu[/url]
Likes: Everything Japanese
Dislikes: Anything Western
Liked food: Red bean soup, matcha
Hated food: Coffee

[url=/c17265]Honoka's[/url] coworker and the Japanese History teacher. She acts completely like a person from the past and looks younger than she is. Due to her younger looks, the students call her different forms of "loli", which is one way to anger her.
